purpose.statement: Detect repeated use within one governed benefit eligibility process.

verifier_set.membership_rule: Accredited programme verifiers listed in registry snapshot RS-2026-07

permitted: same-holder reuse detection within the named programme and epoch
prohibited: linkage after epoch expiry without lawful continuity record

change_control.appeal: Affected persons may challenge context assignment through the programme redress channel.
